text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen wins the Kikuka<n>Sho, while Ines
Fujin collapses from<n>exhaustion after crossing the
finish<n>line. When she comes to, she laments<n>what
happened.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It turns out that when she returned<n>home, she
learned that her sisters<n>quit dancing to take over
housework<n>duties from their sickly mother.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And in an effort to ease her sisters'<n>worries, Ines
took on more part-time<n>work and set about trying to
change<n>the way she runs.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I wish she said something, but I<n>assume she kept it
all to herself<n>because she didn't want anyone
worrying about her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But her worries are my worries too. I<n>promise her
we'll work something<n>out, and we set the Osaka
Hai as our<n>next goal to give ourselves plenty of
time.
